task_headroom.finding: True-label/future-informed B4 headroom is substantial; fidelity-teacher headroom is much smaller.
task_headroom.does_not_establish: An observable or deployable causal opportunity.

objective_mismatch.finding: Fidelity teacher actions disagree with signed task gains; beneficial addition may be cancelled by removal at fixed budget.
objective_mismatch.does_not_establish: A unique causal explanation of final learned-policy failure.

signal_insufficiency.finding: The tested cheap grayscale statistics do not establish useful incremental budget-utility information beyond history.
signal_insufficiency.does_not_establish: Information-theoretic absence or failure of every possible causal signal.

generalization_failure.finding: Prior in-sample utility fails to transfer to OOF/exploratory sources; present head fitting/selection overlap and target-scale shift remain.
generalization_failure.does_not_establish: Untouched independent confirmation or an isolated cause such as distribution shift.

measured_cost.finding: H+M costs more than periodic on all 30 timing groups; unused gating alone is costly.
measured_cost.does_not_establish: An optimized fused path is fast, or overhead is the sole failure mechanism.

population_infeasibility.finding: HMDB51 source allocation fails; exposed UCF cohorts cannot supply a fresh separated four-role evaluation.
population_infeasibility.does_not_establish: Learning failure in the unexecuted HMDB51 study.
